short_description: LYNE Lancer 16 smartwatch with 2.1" TFT display and Bluetooth calling is built for people who want a big-screen watch that feels premium and works fast all day. The large 2.1-inch display makes caller ID, WhatsApp-style alerts, and watch faces easy to read...
description:
LYNE Lancer 16 smartwatch with 2.1" TFT display and Bluetooth calling is built for people who want a big-screen watch that feels premium and works fast all day. The large 2.1-inch display makes caller ID, WhatsApp-style alerts, and watch faces easy to read at a glance. Pair it with your phone and take calls from your wrist using Bluetooth calling—perfect when your phone is in your bag, on charge, or you’re driving or cooking.

The metal body gives it a solid, office-ready look, while the rotating crown makes scrolling menus smooth and effortless. Track heart rate, sleep, steps, and calories, then switch to multi-sports modes for walking, running, cycling and more. With IP65 water and dust resistance and up to 7 days typical battery life, it’s designed for daily wear without constant charging. Choose from 100+ watch faces to match work, gym, and weekend outfits.

features: Big 2.1" TFT display: Large screen makes texts, caller ID and notifications easier to read—great for busy days and quick glances.
Bluetooth calling with speaker + mic: Make and receive calls from your wrist when paired to your phone for hands-free convenience.
Rotating crown navigation: Smooth scrolling through menus and settings without constant swiping—feels faster and more premium.
All-day wellness tracking: Heart rate, sleep, steps and calories to help you stay aware of daily patterns (not a medical device).
Multi-sports modes: Track running, cycling, walking and other activities to stay consistent with your fitness routine.
100+ watch faces: Switch styles for office, gym or weekend looks in seconds.
IP65 water & dust resistance: Handles sweat, dust and light splashes for daily wear (not for swimming or showers).
Smart notifications: Get call, message and app alerts instantly so you check your phone less.
Music control + Find My Device: Control playback and locate your phone quickly when it’s misplaced.
Up to 7 days typical battery: Built to last through the week depending on calling, brightness and notification usage.
